content:
In this session on contaminated soils and rocks, dedicated to the perspective of management entities and soil remediation companies, the concepts, the existing legal framework, innovative soil assessment and remediation techniques and examples, and the opportunities and good practices they should implement will be addressed. Case studies on soil and CDW treatment systems and recycled aggregate recovery will also be analysed, for a deeper understanding of the topic.

Speaking at the session will be António Roque (LNEC), Florence Bouche (Valgo), Leonor Santos (BUILT CoLAB) and Carla Rodrigues (APA), moderated by João Moutinho (BUILT CoLAB).

⏰ 3:00pm – 4:30pm 📌 Register here

This Capacity-Building Action is the second in a cycle of three actions taking place in October, following the protocol BUILT CoLAB established with APA and the Fundo Ambiental under the "Soil Quality Assessment" project.

These events aim to raise awareness among the various stakeholders, from private sector companies to public environmental bodies, about soil quality assessment, risk analysis and sustainable soil remediation processes, thereby contributing to the prevention and combating of soil pollution.
